content:
sre-bot: [INCIDENT] High 5xx spike observed in eu-west1 gateway starting ~10:47 UTC. Alerting and paging. error-rate: 7.8% over 5m, baseline ~0.2% :rotating_light:
alex: paging -> ops-oncall. I'm oncall, looking now. Any recent deploys to eu-west?
maria: we had a model-serving patch at 10:30 but only to dedicated inference pool (not gateway). no infra deploys since 09:50.
inigo: confirming, there was a routing config change pushed 10:40 that adjusted health-check thresholds (by me) — rolling it back now if that looks related.
ops-oncall: ack. i'm running quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n eu-west | grep gateway` -> several gateway pods in CrashLoopBackOff, restart counter high.
alex: logs show `upstream connection reset` and `504 timeout` from mlworker pool. piling up 502/504.
maria: checking ML workers in eu-west: `ps aux | grep mlworker` shows memory pressure on mlworker-3. OOM kills at 10:46. Could be a KV cache thrash.
inigo: rolling back the routing health-change now. command: `rctl route update --env eu-west --health-check-threshold 3` (reverting to 5).
ops-oncall: I scaled gateway replicas +2 in eu-west for now: `kubectl scale deploy/gateway-eu-west --replicas=12 -n prod`. Also evicting mlworker-3 from node: `kubectl drain node/node-27 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` to move pods off bad host.
pagerduty: pager duty note: incident P2 created, incident lead assigned to alex, notify: eng-sre, eng-runtime.
alex: starting cross-region failover plan, steering 30% traffic to eu-central via routing policy to reduce load on eu-west. command: `route-set weight eu-west=70 eu-central=30`. Hold on canary for 2m then ramp.
maria: baseline: customer-impact ~12% of production traffic experiencing 5xx. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/chat/stream.
inigo: rollback completed at 10:58. health-checks restored on new thresholds.
ops-oncall: after routing 30% to eu-central, error-rate in eu-west dropped to 3.2% within 4m, global 5xx now 2.1%. p99 latency eu-west at 1.2s -> 2.8s during spike.
alex: request to ops-oncall: capture node diagnostics from node-27 and upload to /incidents/artifacts/1728003456.
ops-oncall: uploaded tarball: https://storage.redwood/internal/incidents/1728003456/node-27-diagnostics.tar.gz
maria: we saw large KV eviction spikes around 10:44 in redis-cluster-eu, eviction rate 2200/s, causing cache misses and higher backend load. keys with big prefix bulk-deleted earlier. Could be backup job overlap.
inigo: checking backup/cron jobs: there was a backup window that overlapped due to DST shift; backup job to snapshot embeddings triggered at 10:40 and did a full reshard -> this saturated IO on the redis host. Rolling backup schedule and isolating reshard to off-peak.
alex: action items while hot: 1) keep eu-central at 30% until eu-west 5xx <0.5% for 15m 2) remove problematic node from rotation 3) throttle heavy prefix traffic from top 10 customers via rate-limit rule 4) postmortem owner: maria
ops-oncall: applied temporary rate-limit rule: `rlctl create --prefix customers/bulk-upload --max-req 50/s` — reduced incoming load by ~40% for that keyspace.
maria: after eviction drop and node drain, eu-west 5xx down to 0.4% at 11:18. ramping traffic back: route-set eu-west=90 eu-central=10 then eu-west=100 after stability window.
inigo: since root cause tied to backup timing + redis eviction, long-term fix: isolate snapshot reshard to dedicated redis node-group and add I/O governor.
alex: updating incident timeline in ops doc and notifying customer success for impacted tenants. Drafting message: "We observed transient elevated 5xx due to cache eviction and IO saturation in eu-west; we routed traffic to eu-central and applied mitigations; full service restored at 11:22 UTC."
pagerduty: incident severity lowered to P3 at 11:26 after sustained recovery.
ops-oncall: handing off to oncall for postmortem follow-up. alex: take incident lead for PM.
maria: taking postmortem actions: add monitoring alert for redis eviction rate >500/s, add runbook step for scheduling snapshot resharding, and schedule a capacity test for eu-west redis nodes.
inigo: PR created to change backup cron to 03:00 local (PR#4821).
alex: thanks team. final note: total customer impact peaked ~14% of traffic, no data loss. next steps: postmortem in 48h, link to artifacts in doc. :white_check_mark:
ops-oncall: closing: `incident resolved` at 11:22 UTC. Logs and timeline uploaded to /incidents/1728003456/postmortem.md"
